name: prompt-composer
description: Workspace for the OpenCode and Kilo CLI Prompt Composer packages

scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/*.test.ts tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write packages/*/src packages/*/tests tests scripts package.json packages/*/package.json tsconfig*.json packages/*/tsconfig*.json *.config.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check packages/*/src packages/*/tests tests scripts package.json packages/*/package.json tsconfig*.json packages/*/tsconfig*.json *.config.mjs
scripts.check:static: concurrently --names typecheck,lint,format --kill-others-on-fail "npm run typecheck" "npm run lint" "npm run format:check"
